svg.aria-label: The plan mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake: the 3-question simplified interview (stop); Step 0 readiness check: materials and the research question; a missing foundation is sent to deep-research first (agent); Step 1 thesis: INSIGHT thesis_statement (agent); Step 2 chapters, six in order, at least 2 rounds each; a chapter summary after each (agent); Structure architect: the outline from all chapter summaries (agent); Step 2.5 contribution sharpening, at least 1 round; INSIGHT contribution_claim (agent); Step 3 stress test: socratic mentor and argument builder probe each sub-argument (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent) | paper, as built: Intake: the 3-question simplified interview (stop); Step 0 readiness check: materials and the research question (agent); Step 1 thesis: INSIGHT thesis_statement (agent); Step 2 chapters, six in order, at least 2 rounds each; a chapter summary after each (agent); The mentor's question: each answer goes to the mentor, resumed (stop); Structure architect: the outline from all chapter summaries (agent); Step 2.5 contribution sharpening, at least 1 round; INSIGHT contribution_claim (agent); Step 3 stress test: socratic mentor and argument builder probe each sub-argument (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
